name: The Flat Lust Project
source:
You've been offered a contract to develop your own indie project. But you only have four months and many, many distractions around you. Get to finish your project on time, earn enough money with your progress and complete the available relationships to unlock up to five different endings.

[Fom [url=https://pent-panda.itch.io/the-flat-lust-project]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已获得一份开发自己的独立项目的合同。但你只有四个月的时间，周围还有很多很多的干扰。按时完成你的项目，通过你的进步赚取足够的钱，并完成可用的关系来解锁最多五个不同的结局。
